placements.why: This envelope commits the org to a specific database platform (Zypherion) for the analytics pipeline, with a performance rationale and a migration schedule — a technical/platform-grade decision. Existing strata is empty, and no category currently holds infrastructure or system-architecture decisions; Architecture is the natural top-level home for technology and platform choices, mintable standalone (it needs no parent minted first).
placements.title: technical infrastructure and platform decisions
placements.frame: What system, platform, or technology commitments define the org's technical architecture, and how are they justified and scheduled?

placements.title: analytics database platforms chosen through quantified performance rationale
placements.frame: What performance evidence and migration commitments justify each analytics database platform choice, and how does that rationale hold up or shift across later selections?
placements.why: The four segments cohere around one recurring subject: an analytics database platform is chosen and justified by a quantified performance comparison (15x on columnar queries) and paired with a committed migration timeline, then recapped in documentary form. This is a theme future envelopes about infrastructure choices will keep feeding — new platforms, new benchmarks, new migration schedules — not a one-time fact; the specific vendor name, multiplier, and quarter are evidence for the theme rather than leaves of their own (grain test). The graph structure and strata were both empty for this repo, so no existing leaf could plausibly hold this content.
